root_causes.evidence: Network p95 is 2010 ms with 6.2% errors against a 28.5 ms, 0% baseline. Clearing logs show repeated network_send_failed timeouts with items staying pending. The clearing queue is at 137. Every other step of the probe passes.

escalation.reason: Clearing logs show network timeouts and not a malformed item, so item 92 is not poison. The national payment network is failing (p95 ~2 s, ~6% errors against a 28 ms baseline), which is an external outage I must escalate.; The network has worsened from partial to total failure (100% errors, not answering). This is the same external outage, so no allowed action fixes it; I'll update the escalation with the new severity.
escalation.ask: The national payment network, run by another organisation, is timing out. Clearing calls see p95 of about 2010 ms against a 28 ms baseline, with about 6% errors. The clearing queue is building: 137 items, and head item 92 has had 6 attempts. Please contact the network operator to restore service. Our clearing worker is healthy and will drain the queue on its own once the network recovers. Do not quarantine or resend items.; Update: the national payment network is now fully down. Clearing calls fail 100%, with p95 about 2002 ms against a 28 ms baseline. The clearing backlog is 443 items, the oldest waiting 50 s, and nothing has been processed. Please get the network operator to restore service urgently. Payments are still accepted and posted correctly in the ledger, and balances are correct. The clearing worker is healthy and will drain the backlog once the network answers. Do not quarantine, resend or reverse any payments.

sbar.situation: Recovery is not confirmed: after 4 looks, the last at 71 s, the payment journey still fails at the clearing step because the external national payment network is fully down. Clearing has 695 items waiting, the oldest 78 s, and nothing is being processed.
sbar.background: The national payment network, run by another organisation, began timing out, with p95 of 2010 ms and 6.2% errors against a 28.5 ms, 0% baseline. It then went fully down, and clearing calls to it now fail 100%.
sbar.assessment: Root cause is an external outage on the network (confidence 0.85): clearing logs show repeated network_send_failed timeouts, every other probe step passes, and head item 92 has now made 35 attempts. The incident commander escalated to the network operator twice, the second time as a full outage, and the network has not recovered; it did not quarantine, resend or reverse anything, because the clearing worker is healthy and will drain the backlog once the network answers.
sbar.recommendation: Follow up with the network operator on the escalation, and watch for the clearing backlog to drain once service returns; do not quarantine, resend or reverse payments. Operations should review the 695 payments that are accepted and posted in the ledger but not yet cleared, with balances correct, until clearing catches up.
